policy: Each of the144 IDs has independent implementation, unit, integration, native and CI states. complete means implemented, not fully accepted. passed is limited to the described reached assertions. nativeVerified remains partial/blocked when a required desktop platform or scenario is unrun; macOS observations are separately recorded in nativePlatforms. All remote CI states remain not-run/blocked at this checkpoint. Original failed runs are retained and explicitly superseded by later evidence; ID labels alone are never credited.
reviewNotes: Native ID tags were checked against actual script assertions; e.g. Escape-only does not prove Enter/IME, two-client handle equality does not prove independent installer-task counts, and one2x image does not prove all zoom levels.
Native100-cycle attempts remain incomplete; locked-desktop explanation never converts them to passed.
Earlier geometry/capture-expiry/Linux-sysroot shortcomings are superseded by final source and logs.
